horizontal.escena:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent full-bleed narrative or symbolic PHYSICAL PAPER-CUT artwork, never a three-panel collage. All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. Very expressive handcrafted thick matte dyed cardstock: clear pale cut cross-sections, lifted and curled edges, separated shadows between actual layers, deliberate hand-cut curves, folded leaf midribs, cut and folded feather vanes, visibly woven paper fibres, water as overlapping blue sheets and ripples. Heads and faces use few QUIET paper planes with natural proportions; no polygon-faceted CGI cheekbones, shiny skin, plastic dolls or digital-paint substitutes. Whole principal bodies, feet, wings, snouts, tails and ornament tips remain inside frame. The environmental world continues outside all four edges; no visible plinth, frame, diorama perimeter, tabletop, collage, model-sheet layout or printed text. Material depth comes between world layers. Colors differentiate each actor and each narrative rather than cloning the same hunter. Preserve proper reference clothes: bark/fibre covers and sparse seeds, feathers and small quill ornaments where present, no modern shirts, trousers, ponchos or synthetic beads. When a character has a pale nasal quill in the reference, make its near tip plainly visible at the nostril base against skin. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.

MYTH: Jitoma y Fïboi: el Sol y la Luna. FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864. FUNCTION: ENTRADA: expansive environmental situation opening the myth; figures small within the world, not a giant portrait.
Reference 1: P07 — Jitoma agricultor. Jitoma agricultor: tall lean athletic man, diamond high-cheek face, broad natural nose, thick brows, straight black chin-length hair with blunt forehead fringe. A short GOLDEN-YELLOW upright tuft of FOUR feathers on thin woven band and one dark-blue feather at side; narrow bark front/back cover, original small terracotta chevron PAPER across upper chest and separate charcoal forearm band. Sparse black seed necklace with one red seed centre. No nasal ornament. Golden sunlight identity, distinct from long-haired green hunter.
Reference 2: P08 — Fïboi. Fïboi: slender young man, softer oval face, broad mouth, naturally distinct narrower brows, straight black hair to shoulders. LOW charcoal feather circlet with THREE cobalt-blue feathers at one side, a short pale quill nasal ornament, a dark-seed neck strand with one tiny cream disc, narrow pale bark cover with plain waist cord. TWO charcoal horizontal cheek lines separated by unpainted skin. Deep BLUE / cream identity, no white skin or glowing eyes.
Reference 3: B07-pina — Piña. 
Reference 4: A04-42 — Crías de guacamayo · piñas. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Wide humid chagra in golden morning light. TWO whole adult brothers, distinct P07 golden-feather Jitoma and P08 low cobalt-feather Fïboi, stand separated beside a low fallen trunk amid a real pineapple garden. Jitoma holds TWO small pineapple fruits; the TOPS of those same two fruits are becoming tiny whole macaw chicks, while their lower pineapple skins remain visible. One transformation with exactly two pineapple/chick carriers, not four independent objects. Fïboi reaches toward the trunk, preparing to climb. No wife, crowd, weapon attack or random parrot flock. The brothers are small in the cultivated clearing with their complete feet and ornaments visible.

VISIBLE CHECK: Dos hermanos distintos y dos piñas en proceso de volverse crías de guacamayo.
